units.source_text: 天皇驾崩的通告传来时，父亲拿着那张报纸，“唉，唉”地直叹气。

en.t: When the notice of the Emperor's death arrived, my father held the newspaper and kept sighing, "Ah, ah."
"Ah, ah, His Majesty has passed away at last.
I too..." My father did not finish what he was saying.

units.source_text: 我上街买了黑绸子包住旗杆头，

en.t: I went into town and bought black silk to wrap around the top of the flagpole,

units.source_text: 并留出一条三寸宽的黑色飘带，

en.t: and left a black streamer about three sun wide,

units.source_text: 将旗杆斜插在大门边，伸向街道。

en.t: and set the flagpole slanting beside the gate, projecting out toward the street.

units.source_text: 旗子和黑飘带在无风的空气中无精打采地垂着。

en.t: The flag and the black streamer hung limply in the windless air.

units.source_text: 我家的旧门顶上是茅草葺的，

en.t: The roof of our old gate was thatched with straw,

units.source_text: 经过风吹雨打早就变成了浅灰色，

en.t: and after being beaten by wind and rain it had long since turned pale gray,
I went outside the gate by myself,

units.source_text: 望着那黑飘带和白绸子，以及白绸子中央染出的一轮红日，

en.t: and looked at the black streamer, the white silk, and the red sun dyed in the center of the white silk,

units.source_text: 望着那面旗子与灰蒙蒙的茅草房顶相互辉映。

en.t: and looked at how the flag stood out against the grayish thatched roof.

units.source_text: 我想起先生曾问我：“你家的房子是什么样式的？

en.t: I remembered that Sensei had once asked me, "What style is your house built in?

units.source_text: 跟我家乡的民居风格不大相同吧？”

en.t: It must be rather different from the houses in my home region, isn't it?"

units.source_text: 我很想让先生看看我出生的这所旧宅，

en.t: I very much wanted Sensei to see this old house where I had been born,

units.source_text: 却又不好意思让先生看到它。

en.t: yet at the same time I felt ashamed to have him see it.
